patchbank_score — SPC anomaly_patch op

• データ種: image2d × table → table

• 呼び出し: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.patchbank_score(image, model, k=1, smooth=4.0) (実装を直接呼ぶなら import anomaly_patch; anomaly_patch.patchbank_score(image, model, k=1, smooth=4.0)、台帳から引くなら opsspc.get("patchbank_score"))

• GPU: なし(CPU 参照実装のみ)

使い方

Score one image by the distance of each patch to its k nearest good patches in the bank (table).

model comes from patchbank_fit; image must have the training images' shape. The distance (Euclidean, in standardised feature space; the mean over the k nearest) is computed exactly by brute force, interpolated to the image size and smoothed by a Gaussian of smooth px. Returns map (H, W), grid (raw distances), image_score (maximum of the smoothed map), k and smooth.

Raises ValueError for a model that is not a patchbank_fit result, a different image shape, k larger than the bank, or a negative / non-finite smooth.
